summary.selection: summary.results where status == proved and api_path begins alloc:: or std::

records.reason: Copies the exact write-then-assume_init operations and unsafe block. The MaybeUninit::write and Box::assume_init contracts are distinct lower-level calls with no return edge to Box::write, so the proof is ordinary and acyclic.
Copies the exact other.is_subset(self) delegation. The is_subset contract is a distinct lower-level API dependency and creates no cycle.

Copies ManuallyDrop::new followed by Rc::as_ptr on the dereference, preserving ownership and raw-pointer behavior. The as_ptr contract is a distinct acyclic dependency, not a representation substitute.
Mechanically expands Result::unwrap_or_else into a match while preserving Rc::try_unwrap and cloning only the returned Rc on Err. The lower try_unwrap/Clone specifications are acyclic.
Preserves the sole executable test self.len() == 0; the added local and UTF-8 reasoning are proof-only/administrative. The len contract is a distinct acyclic dependency.
Mechanically expands Result::unwrap_or_else into a match while preserving Arc::try_unwrap and cloning only on Err. The lower try_unwrap/Clone specifications are acyclic.

The proof matches the resolved core::result::Result executable body. However std::sync::LockResult<G> is Result<G, PoisonError<G>> (rust/library/std/src/sync/poison.rs:232); the manifest contract and proof instead target core Result with an independent generic E (Result::<T, E>::and). The alias specialization and its fixed/coupled error type are therefore not the actual contract target.
